data.answer: Springs 9 is a gated residential community that offers a tranquil, family-friendly ambiance with abundant green spaces and modern conveniences. Residents enjoy parks and green spaces near Springs 9, swimming pools, and dedicated play areas for children, fostering an active lifestyle. The community is well-secured, with round-the-clock security and maintenance services, ensuring a peaceful and well-managed living environment. Its pet-friendly policies, serene lakes, and jogging tracks further enhance the appeal of suburban living, making it one of the most sought-after neighborhoods in Dubai.

Springs 9 Dubai features a variety of residences, including 2, 3, and 4-bedroom townhouses and 5-bedroom detached villas. Designed with contemporary layouts, these homes offer spacious interiors, private gardens, and covered parking spaces, catering to families and professionals seeking comfortable living in a well-connected community.

Renting a Property in Springs 9

For those looking for properties for rent in Dubai, Springs 9 offers an excellent selection of 2, 3, and 4-bedroom townhouses and 5-bedroom villas for rent. The community’s modern townhouses come with private gardens and spacious interiors, making them an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking a tranquil yet well-connected lifestyle.

Buying a Property in Springs 9

Investors and homeowners searching for properties for sale in Dubai will find Springs 9 an attractive option. The community offers 2, 3, and 4-bedroom townhouses and 5-bedroom villas for sale, featuring contemporary designs, open-plan layouts, and access to world-class amenities, making it a highly desirable residential investment.

Living in Springs 9 means enjoying a blend of suburban charm and modern convenience. With beautifully landscaped parks, serene lakes, and Springs 9 nearby amenities, residents benefit from a variety of leisure, shopping, and dining options. The well-maintained community pools, play areas, and fitness facilities enhance the Springs 9 living experience, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Its proximity to major highways and business hubs makes it ideal for professionals, while the presence of top-tier schools and healthcare facilities ensures a comfortable living experience for families.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Springs 9

Springs 9 Dubai location offers excellent connectivity via Al Khail Road (E44) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), which are 5 and 6 minutes away, respectively. The community is well-planned, with each residential unit featuring private parking spaces, ensuring convenience for homeowners and tenants alike.

Supermarkets near Springs 9

Residents have easy access to Carrefour Market, which is just a 4-minute drive away. This supermarket offers a variety of daily essentials, fresh produce, and household goods, making grocery shopping highly convenient for residents.

Shopping Malls near Springs 9

The Springs Souk, located just 5 minutes away, features a variety of retail stores, dining options, and a Fitness First gym, catering to all lifestyle needs. The mall also houses a cinema and a selection of beauty salons.

The Pavilion in Jumeirah Park, 10 minutes away, offers a range of high-end boutiques, casual dining spots, and essential services, providing residents with an alternative shopping destination close to home.

Schools and Nurseries near Springs 9

Raffles Starters, located within The Springs, offers an Early Childhood Curriculum catering to children from 12 months to 6 years old. This nursery, just 5 minutes away, is known for its nurturing environment and play-based learning approach.

The Dubai British School, located in Emirates Hills, follows the British curriculum from the Foundation Stage to Year 13. Just 6 minutes away, it is one of Dubai’s most reputable schools, providing a well-rounded education with modern facilities.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Springs 9

For Muslim residents, The Springs Mosque and Masjid Bani Hashim, both located within a 5-minute drive, offer peaceful prayer spaces and religious services.

Hindu residents can visit the Shiva Temple and Krishna Temple, both located in Bur Dubai, approximately 25 minutes away. These temples serve as cultural and spiritual hubs for the community.

Christian residents have access to St. Francis of Assisi Church and The United Christian Church of Dubai, both within a 20-minute drive, offering regular services and community gatherings.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Springs 9

Residents have access to Emirates Hospital Clinic in The Springs, located within 5 minutes, offering general medical services and specialist consultations. Mediclinic Meadows, just a 7-minute drive away, provides comprehensive healthcare services, including pediatrics and family medicine.

Springs 9 Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Within Emirates Living, Springs 9 is surrounded by prestigious communities such as The Greens, The Hills, The Lakes, Hattan, The Meadows, and The Views. These neighborhoods offer additional leisure, retail, and dining options.

Beyond Emirates Living, nearby areas include Jumeirah Village Triangle, Jumeirah Islands, Jumeirah Village Circle, and Jumeirah Park, all of which provide diverse residential and lifestyle choices.

Springs 9 offers a wealth of recreational amenities, including scenic parks, lakes, fitness centers, and Springs 9 facilities such as swimming pools and sports courts, ensuring an engaging and active lifestyle for residents.

Springs 9 Restaurants

Dining options near Springs 9 include Asia Tang Restaurant, which serves authentic Asian cuisine with a focus on Chinese and Thai flavors. Big Boss Burger is known for its gourmet burgers made with premium ingredients and bold flavors. 

Zaatar w Zeit offers a variety of Lebanese dishes, including freshly baked manakish and wraps. All these restaurants are located within The Springs Souk, just 5 minutes away, making them convenient dining choices for residents.

Beaches near Springs 9

JBR Beach, approximately 20 minutes away, is a vibrant destination offering pristine sandy shores, water sports, beachfront restaurants, and a lively promenade. Kite Beach, also around 20 minutes away, is popular for its water sports activities, jogging tracks, and a selection of casual beachfront cafés. 

Al Sufouh Beach, known for its quieter ambiance and stunning views of the Burj Al Arab, is located about 18 minutes away, providing a peaceful retreat from the city's bustling environment.

Hotels near Springs 9

Nearby hotels include Vida Emirates Hills, offering luxury stays with golf course views, and Address Montgomerie, known for its upscale hospitality and golfing facilities, both within 15 minutes.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Residents can enjoy outdoor activities such as jogging and cycling along the community’s green pathways. Fitness centers and salons are also readily available within the community and nearby shopping hubs.

Springs 9 Attractions and Landmarks

Montgomerie Golf Driving Range, just 13 minutes away, offers top-tier golfing facilities with a professional driving range and practice greens. Designed by Colin Montgomerie, the course provides breathtaking views of lush fairways, making it an ideal spot for golf enthusiasts.

Dubai International Stadium, also 13 minutes away, is a world-class venue for international cricket matches and major sporting events. With state-of-the-art facilities and a vibrant atmosphere, it is a prime destination for sports fans looking to experience live-action games.

Dubai Miracle Garden, located 14 minutes away, is the world’s largest natural flower garden, featuring millions of colorful blooms. The garden showcases stunning floral sculptures, heart-shaped pathways, and seasonal exhibitions, making it a must-visit for nature lovers.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms and Salons

There are various outdoor activities available to residents of Springs 9. Fitness options include well-equipped gyms, while salons for men and women are also present in the area, ensuring convenient self-care services.

Springs 9 offers a peaceful and family-friendly lifestyle with access to top-tier amenities. While it is primarily a suburban community, its excellent road connectivity ensures that key city attractions and business hubs are easily accessible.

Yes, Raffles Starters and Dubai British School are located within a 5 to 6-minute drive.

How well-connected is Springs 9?

Al Khail Road (E44) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) are just 5 and 6 minutes away, respectively.

What amenities are available in Springs 9?

Residents enjoy parks, pools, playgrounds, jogging tracks, and security services.

Are there healthcare services near Springs 9?

Yes, Emirates Hospital Clinic and Mediclinic Meadows are within a 7-minute drive.

data.content:
Nestled within The Springs, a well-established residential enclave in Emirates Living, Springs 9 Dubai is a tranquil, family-friendly community developed by Emaar Properties. This picturesque neighborhood offers an exclusive selection of townhouses and detached villas, providing residents with a serene suburban lifestyle amid lush landscapes and scenic waterways. Its strategic location ensures easy connectivity while offering a peaceful retreat from the city's hustle.

Situated along Al Asayel Street (D72), Springs 9 enjoys seamless access to Al Khail Road (E44) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), making commutes across Dubai convenient. The community was completed in 2016, boasting contemporary residences designed for comfortable, modern living. With its pedestrian-friendly streets and well-maintained surroundings, it remains a preferred choice among families and professionals seeking a harmonious balance between urban convenience and natural tranquility.

With an emphasis on lifestyle, the Springs 9 living experience is enhanced by a range of amenities, including well-maintained parks, communal pools, and fitness facilities. The neighborhood promotes an active and social lifestyle with designated play areas, landscaped gardens, and scenic walking paths. Springs 9 facilities also include 24-hour security and maintenance, ensuring a safe and well-managed residential environment for all its residents.
